measurement: Local counts with tiktoken o200k_base. field_tokens sums every editable description string (function and parameter descriptions; response-schema descriptions are not editable and not counted). tools_tokens counts the compact JSON of the whole tools array, the part of a request the arms change. Neither is provider-billed usage; the provider tokenizer and chat template differ. The initial catalogue of each in-scope question is counted once per question; held-out miss_func turns are not included. coverage counts, per question, every editable field S saw (edited, then once under each rule that edited it, or kept by reason) and every tool X saw (cued by axis kind, or uncued by the closest refusal). u_anatomy splits the U tools tokens: description kinds are summed field by field; outside_descriptions is tools tokens minus those fields (names, schema, JSON punctuation; approximate, since tokens do not add across field seams); hints and suite preambles are inside function descriptions, and their repeated_ parts are the occurrences after the first tool of the request that carries the same hint or membership.
exposure: pilot_draw (41 cases) and validation_draw (313 cases) have both been flown and diagnosed; they are exposed regression data, not unseen validation.
